Dos dirigentes dimitieron y la Policía británica abrió pesquisas, mientras Farage niega haber infringido la ley.

In a statement, it said: We are considering all relevant information, in line with our regulatory remit, and we are in touch with the Met police.

titulo.es: Giorgia Meloni bate el récord de longevidad al frente de un gobierno italiano
titulo.en: 'Italian opposition fragmented: No alternative leader, no other possible leader than Giorgia Meloni'

sintesis.es: A partir de este viernes, el gobierno de Giorgia Meloni es el más longevo de los 80 años de historia de la República italiana: 1.413 días, es decir, casi cuatro años. Sobre las claves de este hito, el informe de nuestro corresponsal en Roma, Federico Guiglia.
sintesis.en: Alison Sargent is pleased to welcome Political analyst Lorenzo Pregliasco, co-founder of polling agency YouTrend and adjunct professor at the University of Bologna. He argues that Giorgia Meloni’s unusual longevity in office is best understood not simply as a record of political strength, but as the product of a carefully calibrated governing strategy. Meloni has maintained stability partly by avoiding structural reforms disruptive enough to mobilize multiple constituencies against her at once.

titulo.es: Inundaciones devastadoras en la frontera entre Nepal y China dejan más de 1.300 muertos
titulo.en: Devastating floods on the Nepal-China border leave over 1,300 dead

sintesis.es: Crecidas repentinas y corrimientos de tierra en el Himalaya, en la frontera entre Nepal y el Tíbet (China), han causado más de 1.300 muertos y cientos de desaparecidos, con comunidades aisladas y 22.000 personas sin agua potable. Las autoridades continúan operaciones de rescate en centrales hidroeléctricas y túneles, mientras la ONU y UNICEF despliegan ayuda humanitaria de emergencia ante el riesgo de nuevas riadas.
sintesis.en: Flash floods and landslides in the Himalayas along the Nepal-Tibet (China) border have killed over 1,300 people and left hundreds missing, isolating communities and leaving 22,000 people without drinking water. Authorities continue rescue operations in hydroelectric plants and tunnels while the UN and UNICEF deploy emergency humanitarian aid amid the risk of further flooding.

titulo.en: Dark matter detector finds a strange signal scientists can’t yet explain

sintesis.es: The LUX-ZEPLIN experiment has detected a rare particle interaction that looks unusually difficult to explain as ordinary background noise and appeared where dark matter might be expected.
